title.en: Grammar: Types of verse and scansion (பா வகை, அலகிடுதல்)

text.en: Poems have a hidden pattern that you can count.

Tamil verse (பா) has four main types: வெண்பா, ஆசிரியப்பா, கலிப்பா and வஞ்சிப்பா. Each has its own seer pattern and line count. அலகிடுதல் means scanning a line by dividing it into அசை and சீர்.
To scan, mark each syllable as நேர் or நிரை, group them into சீர்கள், and name the foot (e.g. தேமா, புளிமா). Thirukkural is in kural venba, a short form of venba.
Practise scanning two-line kurals and four-line venbas, and note the ending of each type.
